MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 277, December 08, 1970 ]
CREATING THE PRESIDENTIAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE ON THE COPPER INDUSTRY
In order to promote the orderly development of the copper industry and to hasten the further processing of
copper ores and concentrates into blister and refined copper products, and to protect the interests of the
country in the long run, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby establish and create the Presidential Advisory Committee on the Copper
Industry which shall be composed of the following members:
From the Government:
1. Chairman, Board of Investments
2. Secretary of Finance or his representative
3. Director, Bureau of Mines
From the Private Sector:
The chief executives of the copper producing companies, or their authorized representatives
